Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez launched "Project Reactivation NYC" to train activists on reaching 80,000 inactive city voters, coinciding with her statewide tour.

The Poison:
While voter outreach is formally legal, framing bloated, defunct inactive lists as an immediate mass rescue serves primarily as a 2028 campaign branding engine.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing administrative list maintenance with grassroots rescue. The campaign mistakes a low-yield database task for a sweeping democratic breakthrough.

Social Physics Analysis:
AOC's campaign runs a classic Smart Selfish Maneuver: packaging a low-yield database scrub as an urgent crusade to build personal political capital for 2028.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
Modal Dynamics: will be -> is not via Red Top (The Imperial Trap). Selling a utopian democratic rescue that hits the hard wall of reality.

The Unavoidable Truth: Inactive voter lists contain thousands of individuals who have relocated or passed away.

The Unavoidable Lie: This campaign will magically restore tens of thousands of inactive voters.

Classic political grind—slapping a rescue label on an old database to juice headlines and test the waters for 2028.
